08-31-1440 is August 31, 1440.  
16 weeks + 7 days = 17 weeks = 119 days.  
Subtract 119 days from August 31, 1440.  
August has 31 days, so going back:  
Aug 31 - 119 days = Aug 31 → July (31 days in July) → back to June, etc.  

Step:  
From Aug 31:  
Back 31 days → July 31.  
Back another 30 days (June) → June 1.  
Back another 31 days (May) → May 1.  
Back another 30 days (April) → April 1.  
Total so far: 31+30+31+30 = 122 days back from Aug 31 gives April 1, 1440.  
We need 119 days back, which is 3 days later than April 1 → April 4, 1440.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1440-04-04
